directions.precision_fold:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: A refined personal identity concept for Shiv Vyas.
Target dimensions: 1536 x 1024 landscape.
References: Image 1 is the user-liked Isometric Fold logo; image 2 is the user-liked Signal Signature logo; image 3 is the user's restored original portfolio website and is only visual compatibility grounding. The user likes these two logo directions and wants minimal, modern, personal branding for coding, music and photography. Do not redesign or reproduce the website. Do not introduce camera, headphones or laptop icons.
Presentation: one logo concept, displayed large in the left two-thirds on black, with the exact wordmark "Shiv Vyas" below in clean neutral sans-serif, warm white. On the right show the SAME logo's exact flat master silhouette in pure white on black and pure black on a warm-white square. These are applications of one mark, not alternative concepts. Ensure the letter structure and all cutouts are consistent across all treatments. Small understated direction title at the upper left, exactly as specified. Generous spacing, extremely clean professional identity presentation.
Brand palette: black #000000, warm white #f8f8f8, ember orange #f44e00. Only the large sculptural treatment may have orange tonal shading; small proofs must be truly single-color. Clear broad strokes, open negative space, recognizable at small size. No tiny seams, generic cubes, infinity loops, stock audio icons, decorative dots, extra wording, additional identities or existing brand symbols. Avoid looking like a car badge or sports-team logo. The goal is a personal maker identity.

Direction title: "Precision Fold"
Refine image 1 closely. Retain its unmistakable folded angular S feeding into a V, the precise isometric construction and solid orange planes. Tighten the two letters into a more compact unified emblem, reducing the gap so a single ribbon feels continuous. Make the depth shallower and the folds simpler, with subtle rounded bevels. Only three major planar orientations, no extra layers. Matte anodized-orange metal, softly lit against black. Prioritize the original distinctive S-fold silhouette; the V should be equally intentional and clearly legible. The flat small versions should be geometric interpretations of exactly the same face contour, with one clear continuous negative-space path and no tiny slivers. This is the more structured engineering-led direction.

Direction title: "Quiet Signal"
Refine image 2 closely. Preserve the elegance of its one continuous low wave stroke ending in a V valley and ascending terminal. A single rhythmic contour, rounded endpoints and consistent medium stroke weight; warm orange flat primary mark, no 3D, no glow, no gradients. Introduce just a little deliberate asymmetry: a short gently curved initial stroke, a broad confident crest, and a narrower clean V trough, to feel like a personal signature rather than a stock sine wave. Do not force literal typographic S and V if it harms the simple signal shape the user liked. Compress its width slightly so it can sit in a square avatar with comfortable margins. Small black and white proofs must preserve the exact same asymmetric contour. This is the quieter music-led direction and should also make a tasteful photography watermark.

Direction title: "Folded Signal"
Combine the strengths of image 1 and image 2 into ONE new very minimal sculptural emblem. Start from the flowing one-crest, one-valley signal path in image 2. Form it from a single broad continuous ribbon, with just two deliberate isometric folds borrowed from image 1. The left crest subtly forms an S-like reverse curve, then the ribbon transitions into one clean V valley and a rising right terminal. Hybrid of crisp construction and flowing rhythm; do not put a separate letter S beside a separate letter V, do not add loops. 30-degree isometric view, shallow physical depth and soft precise bevels, satin ember-orange material. Show only enough tonal contrast to communicate the folded surfaces, no shiny chrome or transparent glass. The ribbon must remain a simple expressive wave silhouette when flattened into the single-color proofs, not an intricate origami knot. Balancing coding precision, musical flow and photographic composition through form alone.

cleanup.precision_fold:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Target dimensions: 1536 x 1024.
Edit the attached "Precision Fold" brand presentation. Keep the exact logo geometry, folded SV proportions, camera angle, placement, type sizes, words and composition.
Required correction: REMOVE EVERY GLOW, BLOOM, HALO, FOG, LIGHT SPILL AND HAZE. Background must be completely uniform pure black #000000, including behind all text and icons. Nothing is emissive. The main orange folded SV has ordinary subtle studio surface shading and matte orange material; no surrounding orange glow and no sparkling grain. The wordmark "Shiv Vyas" and title are crisp, sharply antialiased text with no halo.
Right upper proof: a true flat pure-white silhouette of the SAME mark on pure black, using black negative-space cuts to clearly show the S and V. NO 3D shading, NO white-on-white seams, NO glow.
Right lower proof: a true flat pure-BLACK silhouette of the SAME mark on a uniform warm-WHITE square. Strong black-on-white contrast. NO bevel, shading, glow, halo or reflection.
Do not change the identity or add any elements. The task is a restrained production-style cleanup of lighting and monochrome rendering.
